x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change interests-and-integrity task 2 (REQ-INT-006, REQ-INT-008, REQ-INT-009). Narrows two declared notifications of fragment 81 to what the spec says. (1) The annual review reminder now has the 12-month cutoff: OpenRegister's scheduled filter grammar has `olderThan` and `any`/`all` (as 130-implementation-progress uses), so a disclosure whose reviewedAt, or declaredAt when never reviewed, is under 12 months old is no longer reminded. (2) The gift notification fires only for a gift at or above its body's threshold: a created-trigger filter can only compare a field for equality, so a declared gift carries `thresholdStatus`, which DeclaredGiftThresholdListener stamps on every save from the body's giftThresholdAmount (EUR 50 when the body has no configuration), and the trigger filters on `above`. Properties only, so no schema version moves, as in 134-decision-authority-basis.

nevenfunctieJaarlijkseReview._note: Annual review reminder (REQ-INT-008). Every 30 days, the holder of a disclosure that has not ended (lifecycle reported, public or internal) and whose reviewedAt, or declaredAt when it was never reviewed, is more than 12 months old is reminded. A disclosure reviewed within the year and an ended one stay quiet. The recipient approximates the holder through object-acl (read), because the person reference is a Person uuid and not a user id. The member confirms through self-service (REQ-INT-010), which writes reviewedAt.

thresholdStatus.title: Against the gift threshold
thresholdStatus.description: Whether the estimated value is at or above the body's gift threshold (`above`) or under it (`below`). Stamped on every save by DeclaredGiftThresholdListener from the body's configured giftThresholdAmount, or EUR 50 when the body has none; a value sent by the client is replaced. Empty while the gift has no estimated value. It drives the integrity notification and the above-threshold badge (REQ-INT-006).

geschenkBovenDrempel._note: Integrity notification on a gift registered at or above its body's threshold (REQ-INT-009, scoped by REQ-INT-006). A gift under the threshold stays quiet. The recipient is the literal integrity group: the dialect cannot read the group from the body's configuration (integrityNotificationGroup), so per-body routing is done through group membership (design D3).
